title: Wash Plates
statement:
You wash plates one by one. Write a function that takes n (number of dirty plates) and returns a list of messages:
"wash plate 1", "wash plate 2", … up to n.
Example: wash_plates(3) → ["wash plate 1", "wash plate 2", "wash plate 3"].
hints: Loop from 1 to n and append a message each time.
Use the loop variable in the message text.

solution.approach: Loop i from 1 to n and collect "wash plate {i}" into a list.
solution.complexity: About n steps — one message per plate.

code.python:
def wash_plates(n: int) -> list[str]:
    return [f"wash plate {i}" for i in range(1, n + 1)]
